description: Search RockAuto.com auto-parts catalogue by keyword or part number. Each query returns up to 50 listings (RockAuto's per-page cap).

categoryFilter.description: Optional: only emit records whose category matches this substring (case-insensitive). E.g. `Brake Pad`, `Oil Filter`.
categoryFilter.title: Category filter

customProxyUrls.description: Premium / alternative residential-proxy URLs (e.g. from BrightData, Oxylabs, SmartProxy). Format: `http://user:pass@host:port`. The actor rotates through these BEFORE falling back to Apify's residential pool. Useful when RockAuto's WAF has flagged Apify's shared residential IPs for high-traffic keywords like `headlight` or `alternator`.
customProxyUrls.title: Custom proxy URLs (optional, advanced)

enrichWithPartDetails.description: When true, fetch the part's RockAuto detail page (moreinfo URL) for each result and add a `details` block (extra specs, fitment notes, image URLs). Adds ~1 extra HTTP request per part — slower but richer.
enrichWithPartDetails.title: Enrich with part-detail data

manufacturerFilter.description: Optional: only emit records whose manufacturer matches this substring (case-insensitive). E.g. `BOSCH`.
manufacturerFilter.title: Manufacturer filter

maxPrice.description: Optional: drop records with price above this amount. Records without a parsed price are kept.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

maxResults.description: Hard cap on parts emitted across all queries (after dedup + filtering).
maxResults.title: Max results

minPrice.description: Optional: drop records with price below this amount. Records without a parsed price are kept.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

queries.description: One or more search terms. Each runs as a separate RockAuto search; results are merged and deduped by part number across queries. Use part numbers, brand names, or category keywords (e.g. `BREMBO P28004`, `oil filter`, `brake pads`).
queries.title: Search queries

startUrls.description: Paste full RockAuto partsearch URLs (e.g. `https://www.rockauto.com/en/partsearch/?partnum=brake+pads`). Each URL's `partnum` becomes a query.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

vehicleEngine.description: Vehicle-mode: engine spec (e.g. `2.5L L4`, `5.7L V8 Hemi`).
vehicleEngine.title: Vehicle engine (optional)

vehicleMake.description: Vehicle-mode: filter `queries` to a specific make (e.g. `Toyota`, `Ford`, `Honda`). Used to narrow keyword search to vehicle-specific parts.
vehicleMake.title: Vehicle make (optional)

vehicleModel.description: Vehicle-mode: filter to a specific model (e.g. `Camry`, `F-150`, `Civic`).
vehicleModel.title: Vehicle model (optional)

title: RockAuto Parts Scraper Input
